description:
Jung Young-Hwan, an outcast who has become the school bullies’ plaything. He is tormented day in and day out, denied even the most basic human dignity. Yet what pains him most is not their violence, but his own weakness—his inability to stand up to them even once. Finally unable to endure the bullying any longer, Young-Hwan attempts to take his own life. And who saves him? None other than my counterpart from a parallel world? 

The Jung Young-hwan from the parallel world was completely different from the Young-Hwan in this world. He had a strong, unwavering attitude and exuded confidence.

 *“…You’re lucky. You don’t have to worry about how much you’ll get beaten today. We’re the same person… so why am I such a pathetic loser?”*

(Source: Naver, translated)
